comment: Confusing and boring lectures. Tests are hard, he grades tough. If you didn't take stats in high school, you'll have a 75 until like mid-semester and then he starts to feel bad and assigns a lot of extra credit. Nice guy, A is attainable, but would avoid him if you can, there are definitely easier professors.
O Durga... Where do I start? He is a cheat sheet GOAt. His lectures are very hard to sit through and he will call you out in class. take him if you need an A in B-skool
Lectures are hard to follow and super long. Tests are manageable, and the 2nd midterm can replace the first. You do get to bring Cheat Sheets to the Exams. Online textbook homework. Pop quizzes.
Lectures can be hard to follow. Homework is manageable. Opportunities for extra credit. Be prepared to learn most of the material on your own.
He's alright at teaching, but wow he was condescending. Constantly seems like he's mad at the world and wants to make it everyone else's problem.

Dr. Gautam was a great professor for my first college econ class. I had no background to microeconomics prior to taking his class. Lectures heavy, straightforward, 3 tests, you can drop the first one if your second one is better. Lots of extra credit opportunities. Homework is one assignment per week online and is due at the end of the weekend.

Oh my sweet sweet durga, I love you so. I will say that he is very hard to understand sometimes but you really do not need to listen. this man WILL give you an A. If you study and do you cheast sheet correctly (you get a cheat sheet on EVERY EXAM) overall if u wanna take micro, take durga he is the GOAT

Lots of opportunities for points and an overall easy class, but I found his lectures incredibly dry and uninteresting making it hard to focus in his class. He also loves to cold call students; if you get the answer wrong, he is condescending. He lectures the whole class period and loves to go on tangents unrelated to the class.

Honestly, he's not the worst teacher and gives a ton of points so it's easy to get an A. The only thing that I would say is that he can be quite condescending when talking to students. His class is super easy so I wouldn't stray away from being in his class, but I honestly don't have that positive of an experience with him
I'm not that great at econ, but still ended up doing well in the class. Make sure you do well on the homework/ other assignments and you'll be fine.

Dr. Gautam truly cares about students. He is kind and means well but his lectures are a little confusing. He explains the basics but often runs out of time to explain the more complicated parts of lessons. You can have a cheat sheet for tests but the questions require you to think. Read the textbook and study and you will do well.

Dr. Gautam is fun to talk to, but his class is very lecture-heavy. You can tell he does care about students, but class can be boring at times. He gives a lot of extra credit opportunities and drops some lowest assignments, but, to me, his exams are sort of tough at times--you do however get a cheat sheet and he is very open to meeting 1-1 for help

Professor Gautam is very caring towards his students. Although his lectures can be boring at times he is overall a very nice guy. I have taken him multiple times and his class is very easy if you are willing to participate in class and form a connection with him.

Dr. Gautam's class was very straight forward. If you did all of the work outside of class and met with him when you could, the concepts would make sense and it would be easy to do well. You do not want to fall behind because the topics do compound.
Pretty inspirational tbh. He gives us a pep talk every class. Lots of pop quizzes that are open note. Overall easy class

Dr. Gautam is a great guy. He really does care about his students and does not want them to fail. His ECON 101 course, however, moved WAY too slowly. He tried his best to be engaging, but the lectures were really dry. I honestly could've just read the textbook and shown up only for exams and done just fine. Insanely easy A, but can be very boring.

One of my favorite professors this semester. His lectures were at a good pace, and the homework he gave helped with my understanding of Econ. He is caring towards all of his students and takes time to get to know everyone. I was sick a lot during this semester and he was always understanding and gave me time to complete my work.
